youtube.title: How to Watch YouTube
youtube.description: Open YouTube in Picture-in-Picture mode and watch videos hands-free

steps.title: Speak the command
steps.description: Say "open youtube" or "watch [video name]"
steps.tip: You can also say "play music videos" or "watch funny cats"

steps.title: Lilly processes your request
steps.description: Lilly listens, recognizes the intent, and launches the app

steps.title: YouTube opens in PiP
steps.description: The YouTube app opens in Picture-in-Picture mode on top of everything

steps.title: Watch while you work
steps.description: Browse videos, search, or just enjoy. Say "skip ad" if an ad plays.

gmail.title: How to Check Email
gmail.description: Open Gmail and read your inbox with a voice command

steps.title: Speak the command
steps.description: Say "open gmail" or "check my email"
steps.tip: You can also say "read my emails" or "check my inbox"

steps.title: Lilly processes your request
steps.description: Lilly authenticates and opens your Gmail inbox

steps.title: Gmail opens
steps.description: Your Gmail inbox opens showing recent emails

steps.title: Browse your inbox
steps.description: Scroll through emails, tap to read, or say "reply" to respond

maps.title: How to Use Maps
maps.description: Open Google Maps and navigate to a destination

steps.title: Speak the command
steps.description: Say "open maps" or "navigate to [place]"
steps.tip: Examples: "navigate to Starbucks" or "directions to the airport"

steps.title: Lilly processes your request
steps.description: Lilly gets your location and opens Maps with the destination

steps.title: Maps opens with route
steps.description: Google Maps opens showing the route to your destination

steps.title: Start navigation
steps.description: Tap start to begin turn-by-turn navigation

camera.title: How to Use the Camera
camera.description: Open the camera app to take photos or record videos

steps.title: Speak the command
steps.description: Say "open camera" or "take a photo"
steps.tip: You can also say "take a picture" or "open camera app"

steps.title: Lilly processes your request
steps.description: Lilly opens the camera app for you

steps.title: Camera opens
steps.description: The camera app opens and is ready to capture

steps.title: Take a shot
steps.description: Point and tap the shutter button, or say "take photo" again

music.title: How to Play Music
music.description: Open YouTube Music and play your favorite songs

steps.title: Speak the command
steps.description: Say "open music" or "play music"
steps.tip: You can also say "play [song name]" or "listen to [artist]"

steps.title: Lilly processes your request
steps.description: Lilly opens YouTube Music and starts playback

steps.title: Music opens
steps.description: YouTube Music opens and starts playing your last playlist or recommended music

steps.title: Enjoy your music
steps.description: Say "pause", "next", or "volume up/down" to control playback

search.title: How to Search the Web
search.description: Search the web using Scrapling-powered search

steps.title: Speak the command
steps.description: Say "google [query]" or "search for [query]"
steps.tip: Examples: "google best pizza near me" or "search for AI news"

steps.title: Lilly searches the web
steps.description: Lilly uses Scrapling to search and extract clean results

steps.title: Results displayed
steps.description: Lilly reads you the top results or shows them in chat

steps.title: Get more details
steps.description: Say "tell me more" or "open the first result" to dive deeper

notifications.title: How to Check Notifications
notifications.description: View and manage your phone notifications hands-free

steps.title: Speak the command
steps.description: Say "what notifications" or "any alerts"
steps.tip: Also try: "what did I miss" or "check my notifications"

steps.title: Lilly reads notifications
steps.description: Lilly reads your notification list and sorts by priority

steps.title: Notifications displayed
steps.description: Lilly tells you about important alerts: calls, messages, app notifications

steps.title: Take action
steps.description: Say "reply" to respond, "call back" to return a call, or "dismiss" to clear

battery.title: How to Check Battery
battery.description: Ask Lilly about your phone's battery status

steps.title: Speak the command
steps.description: Say "how much battery" or "what's my charge"
steps.tip: Also try: "is my battery low" or "battery status"

steps.title: Lilly checks sensors
steps.description: Lilly reads the battery sensor from your Android phone

steps.title: Battery status reported
steps.description: Lilly tells you the percentage, charging status, and health

steps.title: Speak the command
steps.description: Say "who's near me" or "bluetooth scan"
steps.tip: Also try: "scan bluetooth" or "find nearby devices"

steps.title: Lilly scans for devices
steps.description: Lilly activates Bluetooth and scans for nearby devices

steps.title: Devices found
steps.description: Lilly lists nearby devices with names and signal strength

location.title: How to Get Location
location.description: Ask Lilly where you are using GPS

steps.title: Speak the command
steps.description: Say "where are we" or "what's my location"
steps.tip: Also try: "where am I" or "current location"

steps.title: Lilly gets GPS fix
steps.description: Lilly reads the GPS sensor to get your coordinates

steps.title: Location reported
steps.description: Lilly tells you your current city, neighborhood, or coordinates

screenshot.title: How to Take a Screenshot

volume.title: How to Control Volume
